description: Input for proposing a certification: address the target by id or (convenience) by name.

proposed_status.description:
Intent of the proposal: 'certified' to propose trusting this source, 'deprecated' to propose avoiding it (e.g. a stale or wrong source).

* `certified` - certified
* `deprecated` - deprecated

saved_query_id.description: Warehouse view (saved query) id to certify.

table_id.description: Warehouse table id to certify (XOR the other targets).

table_name.description: Queryable HogQL table name; 409 with candidates if ambiguous.

view_name.description: Queryable HogQL view name; 409 with candidates if ambiguous.
